title: P2.7 million in illegal cigarettes intercepted in Pangasinan

blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan — Police confiscated P2.7 million worth of smuggled cigarettes from a cargo hub here after a woman arrested in an earlier law enforcement operation disclosed information about an incoming shipment, authorities said. The 1,350 reams of assorted cigarettes were seized on Monday, following an operation by the Lingayen Municipal Police Station, according to the Pangasinan Police Provincial Office. The shipment, consisting of 27 boxes, was reportedly scheduled for pickup at the cargo hub where it had been stored.
